name: Nether Disciple grants its parry aura at the correct amount (#676)
contract: Nether Disciple 560576 applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (aura 47) with EffectBasePoints=3, DieSides=1, so its real applied amount is 3+1=4 (aura_amount). Player::UpdateParryPercentage() folds that amount into PLAYER_PARRY_PERCENTAGE alongside a flat +5 base and defense-skill terms that flip on once any parry aura is first applied, so the net parry_chance gain is at least the aura's own 4 and can be larger; the wide band below only rules out a zero (unconsumed) result.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Nether Disciple's own aura carries the real EffectBasePoints+1 amount
Parry chance increases by at least the aura's own contribution
